title: SweetPotato
description: Add Sweet potato items in Minecraft.
body:
# SweetPotato
Do you like sweet potatoes? I do.
"SweetPotato" is a mod that adds sweet potato , baked sweet potato and sweet potato block. 
## Install
Verry Easy!
- Step 1: Install NeoForge Loader
- Step 2: Start Minecraft
- Step 3: Stop Minecraft
- Step 4: Place this mod in .minecraft/mods
- Step 5: Fire up Minecraft and enjoy this mod!
